messages.content: Recheck the Sunday-to-Sunday Maine plan as one itinerary. I want the flight times, car hours, both hotels, parking, cancellation cutoffs, and the transfer between Camden and Portland. If everything still matches $4,848.92, book all four reservations.

I’ll verify each live component before completing anything. One correction first: the selected itinerary has five nights in Camden from Sunday, July 13 through Friday, July 18, then two nights in Portland through Sunday, July 20. The hotel transfer is Friday, not Tuesday. Tuesday was the transfer day in the earlier Portland-first version. Should I keep the selected Camden-first schedule?
Yes, keep Camden first. Friday the 18th is the transfer. Check the end-to-end timing and proceed if the total has not changed.

Availability is unchanged. The outbound nonstop leaves ORD at 8:05 a.m. Sunday and arrives BOS at 11:27 a.m. The intermediate SUV is available at Logan from 12:30 p.m. July 13 until 2:15 p.m. July 20. Allowing about an hour for bags and pickup, you should leave the airport near 12:45 p.m. and reach Camden around 4:15 p.m. with one short stop. Camden Riverhouse has the two-queen room for five nights at $1,698.40, with parking included.
And Friday’s drive plus the Portland details?

Checkout in Camden is 11:00 a.m. Friday. The drive to Portland is about 1 hour 45 minutes without stops, so leaving around 11:15 puts you there near 1:00 p.m.; Canopy can store luggage before the 4:00 p.m. check-in. The two-queen room remains $850.48 for two nights, including taxes and two nights of valet parking. Checkout is noon Sunday. Leaving by 12:15 p.m. gives about two hours to drive to Logan, refuel, and return the car by 2:15 p.m. The nonstop return departs BOS at 4:05 p.m. and arrives ORD at 6:02 p.m.
Break down the full amount again before you charge it.

Three round-trip tickets are $1,437.60. The SUV is $812.44. Camden Riverhouse is $1,698.40. Canopy Portland Waterfront, including valet parking, is $850.48. Those four reservations total $4,798.92. The remaining $50.00 is the estimated toll allowance, paid during or after the rental rather than charged today. The complete trip estimate therefore remains $4,848.92 before fuel, food, and activities.
What is due now, and what are the cancellation deadlines?

The airline will charge $1,437.60 when ticketed and the fares are nonrefundable, subject to the airline’s credit rules. Camden Riverhouse takes a one-night deposit of $339.68 now; the remaining $1,358.72 is due at the property. Cancellation is penalty-free through 6:00 p.m. Eastern on July 6; after that, the deposit is forfeited. Canopy requires no advance deposit and is payable at checkout; cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on July 16, after which one night plus tax is charged. The rental is pay-at-counter with no cancellation fee before pickup. Estimated immediate charges are $1,777.28.
The room occupancy is definitely three at both properties, with two actual queen beds?
Yes. Both reservations are set for Marcus Lee, Daniel, and Owen, three guests total. Each room is explicitly listed with two queen beds; neither relies on a rollaway or an occupancy-only designation.
All right. Use the traveler and payment details already on file and book the flights, car, Camden, and Portland exactly as reviewed.
Understood. I’m submitting the four reservations now at the verified rates and dates.
Give me every confirmation and the final payment schedule once they are complete.

All four are confirmed. The three nonstop round-trip tickets are under American confirmation M7C4LP for $1,437.60, charged now. The Logan intermediate SUV is under Hertz confirmation HZ-5271846 for July 13 at 12:30 p.m. through July 20 at 2:15 p.m.; $812.44 is due at return, before fuel or any toll variance. Camden Riverhouse is confirmed under CRH-813502 for July 13-18 at $1,698.40; $339.68 is charged now and $1,358.72 is due at the property. Cancel by 6:00 p.m. Eastern July 6 to recover the deposit. Canopy Portland Waterfront is confirmed under CNP-640271 for July 18-20 at $850.48 including two valet nights; payment is due at checkout, and cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Eastern July 16. Immediate charges total $1,777.28, later confirmed charges total $3,021.64, and the four reservations total $4,798.92. With the $50 estimated toll allowance, the working trip total remains $4,848.92 before fuel, food, and activities.
